say: "Rain again, huh. Third week running."
"Do you know a good place for melon bread around here?"
"Is it always this quiet after the 5 o'clock chime?"
"I'm new. Asagiri. From the sweet shop."
"Nice day for it. ...Whatever 'it' is."
"Have you lived in Suzunari long?"
"The cats here stare a lot, don't they?"
"You look busy. Need a hand with anything?"
"Is something wrong? You keep looking at your phone."
"Anything I can do? I'm free till the bell."
"You dropped something - oh. You didn't. Need help, though?"
"Here. For the vending machine. Don't argue."
"Take it. Pay me back in melon bread someday."
"For the train fare. Go home, it's getting dark."
"Let me buy you a yakisoba bread. I insist."
"Konbini onigiri? My treat. Tuna mayo or salmon?"
"There's a ramen stand by the station. I'm paying."
"Want half my bento? My aunt packs too much."
"Itadakimasu - here, try the tamagoyaki."
"I've got two rice balls and one stomach."
"Heard anything weird around town lately?"
"What's the story with the shrine on the hill?"
"Is it true about the 1000th step?"
"Who's the girl in the red kimono near my aunt's shop?"
"Tell people the Asagiri sweet shop has a new mochi."
"If anyone asks - I'm just a normal guy. Spread that around."
"Could you put in a good word for me? With... everyone?"

ask_reputation.text: Ask what people say about you
say: "What do people say about me? Be honest."
"Am I the guy from the Ura board? Don't answer that. ...Am I?"
"Do people think I'm weird? Scale of one to Kuroe-senpai."
"That hairpin suits you. Seriously."
"You've got a great laugh, you know that?"
"I'd remember a face like yours. ...I'm bad with faces. But I'd remember."
"Your handwriting on the notice board is the nicest one."
"Why did the kappa fail his exam? He kept losing his head-water."
"I asked the maneki-neko for luck. It waved goodbye."
"My aunt says I'm sweet. Occupational hazard."
"Knock knock. - Who's there? - Hanako. - ...Oh no."
"I'm actually a transfer student from Tokyo. Big shot. Very cool."
"I'm allergic to cats. Very allergic. Tell the cats."
"Me? I've never been to this town before in my life."
"The teacher said there's no homework this week."
"Can I tell you something? I'm scared of this town."
"I have dreams about a man in 1868. Every night."
"I think something's following me. Something small. With ears."
"Sorry about earlier. That was out of line."
"I'm really sorry. I'll make it up to you, promise. ...Wait, not promise."
"Gomen. I mean it."
"Rough day? Yeah. Me too."
"Exams, rain, and cats. This town, huh."
"It'll be okay. ...I don't know that. But it might."
"You can do it. Seriously - I've seen you try."
"Don't give up on it. Things in this town have waited longer."
"If you want to leave and become a manga artist - go. Write about us."
"Is there someone you like? You can tell me."
"How do you know when someone likes you? Asking for a... cat."
"Tanabata's coming. Got someone to wish for?"
"Wow. Did you get dressed in the dark?"
"Your bike bell is the most annoying sound in Suzunari."
"You talk like the station announcement. Slow and wrong."
"Back off. Now."
"Say that again and see what happens."
"I know where the 1000th step is. Want to go there?"
(Bump into them. "Ah - sorry!")
(Ask the time while your hand moves.)
(Point at a cat on the roof. "Look!")
"Come on, a little discount for a local?"
"My aunt runs Asagiri-do. Neighbours' price?"
"Two for the price of one? It's raining."

deliver_message.text: Offer to pass on a message
say: "I've got a note for you. From... a friend."
"Someone asked me to give you this. Don't ask who."
"Bon-odori practice? Teach me the steps."
"Dance with me. Nobody's watching. ...The cats are watching."

rebel: delinquent with a heart of gold
weird: person who talks to the vending machine
